content.json:
# Amsterdam 750 observability
Productiontelemetrie voor de public en admin Function Apps. Gebruik de tijdselector per onderdeel om requests, fouten, responstijden en exceptions te onderzoeken.

content.query:
requests
| summarize Requests=count(), Failures=countif(success == false), Availability=round(100.0 * countif(success == true) / count(), 2), P50=percentile(duration, 50), P95=percentile(duration, 95), P99=percentile(duration, 99) by cloud_RoleName
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Kerncijfers

content.query:
requests
| summarize Requests=count(), Failures=countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, 5m), cloud_RoleName
| order by timestamp asc
| render timechart
content.title: Requestvolume en fouten

content.query:
requests
| summarize Average=avg(duration), P95=percentile(duration, 95), P99=percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, 5m), cloud_RoleName
| order by timestamp asc
| render timechart
content.title: Responstijd

content.query:
exceptions
| summarize Count=count(), LastSeen=max(timestamp) by cloud_RoleName, type, outerMessage
| top 20 by Count desc
content.title: Meest voorkomende exceptions
